verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API for managing models. Community users confirm a smooth CLI workflow for downloading and removing models ('ollama pull' / 'ollama rm') and call model management its strength. Nothing in the pack shows saved-prompt management or per-model configuration in a unified place, so only one of the story's three elements is delivered. Missing for 10: saved-prompt management, per-model configuration management, a single unified interface covering all three, and first-party docs detailing model-management workflows.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
One 'ollama pull' and it's available. Underwhelming? 'ollama rm'.
llama.cpp does almost everything ollama does better except model management.
